provenance.l: Apollo 14 Mission Report MSC-04112 (May 1971): Table 6-I (docking 143:32:51, LM jettison 145:44:58), Table 6-V (ascent 432.1 s, 6,066.1 ft/s; vernier, TPI, TPF burns; TEI 148:36:02.3, 149.2 s, 3,460.6 ft/s), range zero 21:03:02 GMT 31 January 1971. All times are the Mission Report clock, not the Flight Journal clock (which runs 40 min 2.9 s ahead after 054:53:36). Quote: "A direct rendezvous was performed using the ascent propulsion system to perform the terminal phase initiation maneuver."

NASA SP-4029 Apollo 14 summary: "Ignition of the ascent stage engine for lunar liftoff occurred at ... 141:45:40"; "The 432.1-second firing of the ascent engine placed the vehicle directly into a 51.7 by 8.5 n mi orbit" (the insertion GET 141:52:52 is liftoff plus that burn); vernier adjustment 10.3 ft/s at 141:56:49.4, TPI 142:30:51 (APS, 3.6 s, 88.5 ft/s), TPF 143:13:29.1 (RCS, 26.7 s, 32 ft/s): the first direct (one-revolution) rendezvous, no CSI or CDH

Postflight Evaluation of the Apollo 14 Spacecraft Trajectories (MSC 04330, 26 May 1971): docking 143:32:50.5, TEI 148:36:02, CSM orbit 61.5 x 58.2 n.mi at docking, 63.4 x 56.8 after the separation burn
